sloka: साध्याश्च विश्वेदेवाश्च सर्वे च परमर्षयः ।नागाः सुपर्णाः सिद्धाश्च ते सर्वे हृष्टमानसाः ।सीताशपथसम्भ्रान्ताः सर्व एव समागताः ।। ७.९७.९ ॥
transliteration: sādhyāśca viśvedevāśca sarve ca paramarṣayaḥ ।nāgāḥ suparṇāḥ siddhāśca te sarve hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ।sītāśapathasambhrāntāḥ sarva eva samāgatāḥ ।। 7.97.9 ॥

translations.english: The Sadhyas, Vishvedevas, all great sages, Nagas, Suparnas, and Siddhas, all of them with joyful minds, agitated by Sita's oath, had indeed assembled there.
